caption: The first screen of the app, Choose your website template: Select a starting template. You can easily switch it at any time. You can also skip this step and we'll choose one for you. Subject list on the left and Recommended Templates on the right, with the button Skip for now. The interface is in English and no personal data is shown.

The dashboard Home of the new site: a card Finish getting set up with the tasks Get a discount for your first subscription payment (15% off, button Tell us more), The Design area, Add an image, Create a holding page, Register a Domain and Publish your website, a card Top Tips To Get Started, and at the bottom the bar You have 29 days remaining on your trial. Upgrade now to enable your website. with the button Upgrade Now. The user name at the top right, the site name card, the avatar and the name of the helper on the help card are covered by dark boxes or grey boxes.

The Image Library with the buttons Upload Image and Import Stock Images and one image, orange-blue-and-white-yarn-ahMCpXdUjv0.jpg, selected, and the button Done. The page title and the user name are covered by dark boxes.

The page editor after the edit: the added block with the heading Hello from my test page under the testimonials of the template, the message Save successful, the buttons Add Block, Reorder Blocks and Done, and the trial bar at the bottom. The page title and the user name are covered by dark boxes; the three sample testimonials of the template (names and photos) are covered by grey boxes.
